channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Presidente, pela relevância do cargo, merece foro privilegiado, diz Zema
item.description: Novo presidential candidate Romeu Zema defended ending privileged forum for all positions except the presidency during an SBT sabatina. The proposal is part of his government plan.

item.title: Tarcísio fala pela primeira vez que 'talvez' dispute Presidência no futuro
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) admitted for the first time that he may run for President of Brazil in the future. In an interview with Jovem Pan News, he replied "Maybe" when asked about a potential presidential bid.

item.title: Zema sugere mudar Constituição para liberar Estados a legislar sobre crimes
item.description: Novo party presidential candidate Romeu Zema proposed a constitutional amendment to allow states to legislate on penal and criminal matters. The suggestion was made during an SBT News interview this Wednesday.

item.title: PT quer ampliar participação feminina, mas mulheres são minoria
item.description: PT will field 404 female candidates in 2026 (36.8% of total), the party's highest proportion ever, yet still below parity. Overall PT candidatures fell 32.7% from the 2002 peak. Janja Lula da Silva advocates 50% women in Congress and calls the current 30% quota insufficient.

item.title: O novo gesto de aproximação de Michelle Bolsonaro a Flávio
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro posted a behind-the-scenes video with Flávio Bolsonaro, sealing reconciliation after a dispute over alliances in Ceará. Both recorded together for Flávio's presidential campaign and Michelle's Senate run.

item.title: Tebet critica gestão Tarcísio por falta de verba para delegacias da mulher
item.description: Senate candidate Simone Tebet (PSB) criticized São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) for insufficient funding to keep women's police stations open 24/7. Tebet cited data showing increased violence against women on weekends and record feminicides in Q1 2026.

item.title: Fazenda avalia mudar Move Brasil para atrair bancos privados
item.description: The Finance Ministry is evaluating changes to the Move Brasil program to boost private bank participation in vehicle financing for app drivers and taxi drivers. Currently, Banco do Brasil and Caixa dominate lending, while overall uptake remains below expectations. Simultaneously, the government is pushing Congress to approve the provisional measure that zeroed the 'blusinhas tax' (20% levy on international purchases up to US$50), with a September 8 deadline.

item.title: Republicanos expulsa prefeito tiktoker Manga por infidelidade partidária em votação unânime
item.description: The Republican Party unanimously expelled Sorocaba mayor Rodrigo Manga for party disloyalty after he publicly campaigned for his wife, Sirlange Maganhato, a federal deputy candidate from União Brasil. Manga’s party affiliation had been suspended since July, and he was removed from office in November 2025 over health‑fund investigations, only to be reinstated in March 2026 by a STF injunction. He also faces prosecution for organized crime, money laundering and related charges stemming from Operation Copia e Cola.

item.title: Prefeita do PT no interior de MG declara apoio a Cleitinho ao governo do Estado
item.description: The mayor of Frei Gaspar (MG), Jackeliny Pereira do Nascimento (PT), endorsed Senator Cleitinho (Republicans) for Minas Gerais governor, breaking with the PT's official candidate Patrus Ananias, backed by Lula. In an Instagram post, she assembled a slate including Lula for presidential re-election, Cleitinho for governor, Marília Campos (PT) and Marcelo Aro (PP) for Senate, plus allied deputies. Cleitinho has publicly stated he is not Lula's ally.

item.title: Em evento com Michelle, Gaspar ataca Lula: "Caloteiro da esperança"
item.description: At the launch event for Izalci Lucas's (PL) federal deputy candidacy, Alfredo Gaspar, running mate of Flávio Bolsonaro, attacked Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, calling him Brazil's 'biggest hope defaulter' and accusing the government of a R$10 trillion public debt. Gaspar also linked the Lulinha case to alleged corruption involving former chief of staff Marcola, claiming Lula and his son will be indicted and imprisoned.

item.title: Diretor do Paraná Pesquisas explica o curioso fenômeno do voto Tarcísio-Lula
item.description: Paraná Pesquisas poll shows 15% of São Paulo voters intend to vote for Tarcísio de Freitas for governor and Lula for president. This cross-voting creates a strategic dilemma: closer ties between Tarcísio and Flávio Bolsonaro or between Lula and Haddad could alienate these voters, though Tarcísio's current lead remains substantial.

item.title: MP pede ao TSE a impugnação da candidatura de Pablo Marçal à presidência
item.description: The Electoral Public Ministry requested the TSE to block Pablo Marçal's (PRTB) 2026 presidential candidacy, citing ineligibility due to convictions from the 2024 São Paulo mayoral campaign and irregular party affiliation, as Marçal was affiliated with União Brasil in April, violating the six-month minimum affiliation requirement for the PRTB.

item.title: Flávio e Michelle gravam vídeo juntos com jingle eleitoral
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro and Michelle Bolsonaro released a joint video with an electoral jingle, announcing their reconciliation after disagreements over party alliances. Published on August 19, 2026, the video features the slogan “Let’s start on the right foot, Brazil has a future” and shows mutual support for their presidential and Senate bids. The rapprochement follows a period of estrangement and precedes the formalization of their candidacies.

item.title: Durigan quer discutir ajuste fiscal com Pedro Malan e Arminio Fraga
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan is arranging meetings with former ministers Pedro Malan and Arminio Fraga to discuss fiscal adjustment in Lula's third term. The talks are expected to take place in August in Rio de Janeiro.

item.title: ‘Talvez’, diz Tarcísio ao ser questionado se pretende disputar Presidência no futuro
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas admitted for the first time he might run for president in the future, answering "maybe" in a Jovem Pan interview. He also supported civic-military schools, amnesty for January 8 convicts, and opposed new metro and CPTM privatizations.

item.title: Michelle publica primeiro vídeo de campanha ao lado de Flávio após crise
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro released her first campaign video alongside stepson Flávio Bolsonaro, a presidential candidate, signaling reconciliation after a public feud.

item.title: Durigan deve se encontrar com economistas do governo FHC para falar sobre eventual Lula 4
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan will meet with economists Arminio Fraga and Pedro Malan, who served under Fernando Henrique Cardoso, to discuss economic policy for a potential fourth Lula term. The meeting will take place in Rio de Janeiro in the coming days.

item.title: MPE pede à Justiça que barre candidatura de Marçal
item.description: The Electoral Public Ministry asked the Superior Electoral Court to deny Pablo Marçal's (PRTB) presidential candidacy registration, also requesting that he be barred from using public campaign funds and appearing in electoral propaganda.

item.title: A possibilidade de virada na disputa Tarcísio x Haddad, segundo diretor do Paraná Pesquisas
item.description: According to Paraná Pesquisas, Tarcísio de Freitas leads Fernando Haddad with 50% versus 33.8% in voter intention, suggesting a likely first‑round win. Director Murilo Hidalgo says only an extraordinary event could change the race, noting Tarcísio’s lower rejection and incumbent governor advantage, which are especially strong in São Paulo’s interior.

item.title: Valdemar atribui crescimento de Flávio a Michelle: “Paz na família”
item.description: PL president Valdemar Costa Neto attributed Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's rise in the Genial/Quaest poll to Michelle Bolsonaro's involvement in the campaign, citing family peace and her charisma. He noted the effect was already evident in the first week.

item.title: STF amplia Lei Maria da Penha para violências sem vínculo doméstico
item.description: The STF unanimously ruled to extend Maria da Penha Law protective measures to gender-based violence outside domestic contexts, covering professional, institutional, social, and political settings. Ministers Flávio Dino and Cristiano Zanin added provisions on political gender violence and judges' duty to assess urgent requests immediately. Cármen Lúcia warned of regression after 20 years, citing the violation of Maria da Penha's own protective order by her ex-husband, who was preventively arrested.

item.title: Marçal chama Renan Santos de ‘Lula 2.0’ após ser criticado
item.description: Pablo Marçal responded to Renan Santos' criticism by calling him 'Lula 2.0' and predicting he will get only 1% of votes. The clash between Marçal and the MBL leadership escalates with mutual accusations about each candidacy's role on the right.

item.title: Durigan espera diálogo com EUA após “eventual tentativa de interferência”
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan expects Brazil-US diplomacy to normalize after the 2026 election period, citing a potential interference attempt. The government continues negotiating to offset Trump's tariffs, with measures including a new Brasil Soberano program and drawback extension.

item.title: MP pede ao TSE que barre candidatura de Pablo Marçal à presidência
item.description: The Electoral Public Ministry asked the Superior Electoral Court to reject the candidacy of Pablo Henrique Costa Marçal for the 2026 presidency, citing his conviction for improper use of communication media in the 2024 municipal elections, which renders him ineligible until 2032. The MPE also requested a preliminary injunction to block his access to public campaign funds and free airtime. Marçal’s registration remains pending approval by the Electoral Justice.

item.title: Lula tem encontro com advogado de Lulinha no Palácio da Alvorada
item.description: Lula held an unscheduled meeting with his son Lulinha's lawyer amid three Supreme Court-authorized investigations into alleged influence peddling and corruption involving medicinal cannabis deals, Dataprev contracts, and favoritism for partner companies. The president missed the STJ inauguration ceremony, replaced by Vice President Alckmin.

item.title: Caiado evita tomar posição sobre fim da escala 6×1
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticized the PEC ending the 6x1 work scale as an electoral maneuver by Lula's government, but avoided stating whether he supports or rejects the proposal during a CNT event.

item.title: Zema propõe idade mínima de 60 anos para indicados ao STF
item.description: Novo party presidential candidate Romeu Zema proposes raising the minimum age for Supreme Court justices from 35 to 60. The Constitution currently sets a minimum of 35 and maximum of 70. Zema argues the change would bring more maturity and experience to the Court.

item.title: Veja o que é #FATO ou #FAKE na entrevista de Fernando Haddad ao 'Globo', 'Valor' e CBN
item.description: The Fato ou Fake team fact-checked Fernando Haddad's statements in a sabatina. His claim of authoring the PPP law was rated TRUE, while his criticism of Sabesp and Tarcísio de Freitas was rated NOT EXACTLY TRUE, as Procon's complaint counting has a specific methodology.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro posta 1º vídeo com Flávio após briga
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro and Flávio Bolsonaro released a joint video showing political reconciliation after a period of disagreements. In the footage, both smile, interact, and reciprocally ask for votes for Senate (DF) and Presidency, respectively, displaying ballot numbers for use in electoral advertising.

item.title: Michelle publica vídeo com bastidores de gravação com Flávio Bolsonaro para campanha eleitoral
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro released behind-the-scenes footage of a campaign recording with Flávio Bolsonaro, marking her first active participation in his presidential campaign after a public reconciliation. The former first lady, running for Senate in the Federal District, recorded with the senator on August 11, with the material published on August 19.

item.title: Ministério Público Eleitoral pede ao TSE que barre candidatura de Pablo Marçal à presidência e o impeça de participar de debates
item.description: The Electoral Prosecutor's Office asked the Superior Electoral Court to reject Pablo Marçal's presidential candidacy, citing an eight-year ineligibility from a conviction for improper use of media and a party affiliation irregularity. The prosecution also requested that Marçal be barred from debates and public campaign resources pending final judgment.

item.title: Posse do STJ tem ausência de Lula, cochicho de Alcolumbre e Gonet e cumprimento entre Mendonça e ministro da Justiça
item.description: The inauguration of the new STJ president, Luís Felipe Salomão, took place without President Lula, who was replaced by Vice President Geraldo Alckmin at the authorities' table. Informal exchanges occurred, such as whispers between Senate President Davi Alcolumbre and Prosecutor-General Paulo Gonet, and a cordial greeting between Justice Minister Wellington César and Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça. Although Lula was absent, several ministers and parliamentarians attended, including Alagoas gubernatorial candidate JHC.

item.title: Tebet diz que só um democrata foi ao 2º turno em 2022
item.description: Simone Tebet stated that only one democratic candidate reached the 2022 runoff, referring to Lula, and reaffirmed her support for the president, saying she would do it all again.

item.title: Veja o que é #FATO e o que é #FAKE na sabatina de Fernando Haddad ao GLOBO, Valor e CBN
item.description: The Fato ou Fake team fact-checked two statements by Fernando Haddad during his interview with GLOBO, Valor and CBN. His claim of authorship of the PPP Law was rated TRUE, as documents confirm his role in drafting the 2003 bill. His criticism of Sabesp as 'Procon complaint champion' was rated NOT QUITE SO, since the agency tallies complaints in different ways.

item.title: Salomão diz que filtro de relevância dará “nova lógica” ao STJ
item.description: New STJ President Luis Felipe Salomão took office on August 19, 2026, announcing the relevance filter implementation as his main challenge to focus the Court on high-impact cases. He also plans a 2027 fund for Federal Justice re-equipment if Bill 429/2024 is sanctioned, and emphasized priorities including decision quality, transparency, access to justice, and ethical AI use.

item.title: Ministro da Fazenda busca reunião com Pedro Malan e Arminio Fraga para discutir agenda fiscal
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan is seeking meetings with former FHC-era economic leaders Pedro Malan and Arminio Fraga amid criticism of Brazil's exploding public debt. Durigan also met with Marcos Lisboa and acknowledged that long-term Treasury rates are unacceptably high, with the effective debt cost reaching a ten-year peak.

item.title: Lula usará 4º discurso na ONU para “reagir” aos EUA
item.description: Lula will deliver his 4th UN speech in September, addressing sovereignty, economy, democracy, and foreign interference, particularly US tariffs. The government seeks a meeting with Trump, but bilateral relations are tense ahead of Brazil's presidential election. A firmer tone than in 2025 is expected, following the explicit 'Monroe Doctrine' and 'Trump Corollary' in US foreign policy.

item.title: Caiado critica Lula por 'viés eleitoreiro' do fim da 6x1, mas não diz se é contra ou a favor da medida
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticizes Lula for alleged 'electoral bias' in the PEC ending the 6x1 work scale, but avoids taking a clear position for or against the measure.

item.title: Advogado de Lulinha se reúne com Lula
item.description: President Lula met with lawyer Marco Aurélio de Carvalho, who represents his son Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), at the Alvorada Palace. The meeting takes place amid Federal Police investigations targeting the businessman.

item.title: ‘Vivemos uma juristocracia’, afirma Pablo Marçal sobre decisões Judiciário
item.description: Pablo Marçal criticized the superior courts, stating that Brazil lives under a "juristocracy" due to the Judiciary's expansion into Legislative and Executive matters.

item.title: TSE forma maioria para derrubar posts de Flávio e aliado; Nunes Marques pede vista
item.description: The TSE formed a majority to order the removal of posts by Flávio Bolsonaro and Marcelo Queiroga linking the PT to organized crime. Rapporteur André Mendonça had denied the injunction, but five ministers disagreed. The trial was suspended after Chief Justice Nunes Marques requested a stay.

item.title: Zema defende impeachment e prisão de ministros do STF: ‘Corrupção corre solta’
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) advocated impeachment and imprisonment of Supreme Court justices, accusing them of corruption and citing trips on ex-banker Daniel Vorcaro's jet. He criticized Lula's appointments, called Jan 8 convictions unjust, pledged pardon for Bolsonaro, and proposed Court reforms, labor flexibility, and foreign policy alignment with US and Europe.

item.title: Confira como foi a quarta-feira dos candidatos a presidente
item.description: Four presidential candidates campaigned on Wednesday (19): Hertz Dias (PSTU) advocated for education investment in Juiz de Fora; Renan Santos (Missão) monitored removal of criminal faction cameras in João Pessoa; Romeu Zema (Novo) criticized food inflation and defended spending cuts in São Paulo; Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) proposed AI in healthcare and better highways in Brasília.

item.title: PT tem menor número de candidaturas desde as eleições de 1994
item.description: The PT has its fewest candidacies since 1994, with 1,097 candidates in 2026, a fourth consecutive decline. The party is aging: growth in candidates over 60, while younger candidates decrease. Male candidacies dropped 36.6% since 1994; female candidacies fell for the second straight election. Black candidates represent 49.5% of the total. Internally, no consensus successor to Lula emerges, with names like Haddad, Boulos, Santana, Costa, Fonteles, and João Campos mentioned but lacking unity.

item.title: Tebet: "Falta em São Paulo vontade política de proteger as mulheres"
item.description: Simone Tebet (PSB), Senate candidate for São Paulo, criticized lack of political will to protect women in the state, noting only 26% of R$10 million allocated for combating violence against women was committed. She advocated for 24/7 women's police stations and discussed STF minister impeachment proceedings.

item.title: MP pede que TSE barre candidatura de Pablo Marçal e que ele seja proibido de fazer campanha
item.description: The Electoral Prosecutor's Office asked the TSE to bar Pablo Marçal's 2026 presidential candidacy, citing ineligibility until 2032 for misuse of media and party affiliation irregularities. Marçal is affiliated with União Brasil since March but seeks to run for PRTB with a retroactive affiliation injunction, despite evidence showing he presented himself as a União Brasil member after the legal deadline.

item.title: Ministério Público Eleitoral pede que TSE rejeite registro de candidatura de Pablo Marçal
item.description: The Electoral Public Ministry asked the TSE to reject Pablo Marçal's (PRTB) presidential candidacy registration for 2026, arguing he was not affiliated with the party by the legal deadline (April) and remains ineligible until 2032 due to a 2024 conviction for misuse of media. The MPE also requests a provisional measure to block his campaign and access to public funds.

item.title: Reunião no TSE termina sem aval para liberar 'deepfake do bem', e ministros sinalizam rigidez maior para uso de IA
item.description: The TSE meeting on deepfakes in the 2026 elections ended without consensus and no date set to judge a video simulating Bolsonaro endorsing his son Flávio. Ministers indicate a tendency to explicitly prohibit AI manipulation of human figures during campaigns, tightening current rules and blocking platforms from hosting such content. Recent virtual plenary rulings ordered removal of deepfakes, though the isolated case is unlikely to result in the senator's impeachment.

item.title: Durigan: reciprocidade não atrapalhará negociação do Brasil com os EUA
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan stated the Reciprocity Law won't hinder negotiations with the US and may even help dialogue. Brazil launched diplomatic consultations over the 37.5% US tariff but maintains full willingness to negotiate, including direct talks between Lula and Trump.

item.title: A turma da força no STF se acha vítima de uma conspiração
item.description: The article criticizes the STF faction led by Moraes, Dino, and Gilmar, who portray themselves as victims of a conspiracy funded by elites and NGOs. The Court has lost legitimacy by being perceived as captured by private interests, while attempting to control investigative journalism. Lula-Bolsonaro polarization persists, but institutional unease is widespread.
